items.prompt: Which component implements the NOTICE phase in the running case study?
options: Pinned Apify actors fetching each source on a schedule, plus a normalize+dedupe pass
items.explanation: Actors fetch the world on schedules; normalize hashes and validates required fields; dedupe checks seen.json. The policy decides, telegram notifies, the digest reports — different phases, different components. (obj-03-a)

items.prompt: Match the artifact: what does the LEARN phase write when a publish's outcome is being watched?
options: Gate states (open/satisfied/unmeasured) and micro-lesson dispatch receipts
items.explanation: LEARN evaluates revert gates on the 15-minute schedule and dispatches micro-lessons for stuck learners; its artifacts are gate states and dispatch receipts. Snapshots belong to NOTICE, diffs to ACT. (obj-03-a)

items.prompt: In the end-to-end trace, which single fact made the npm package page decisive for the publish?
options: It provided the second independent publisher voice — releases and docs are one vendor (n8n)
Its snapshot had the largest hash
items.explanation: Independence is counted in publisher voices, not URLs: n8n's release notes and docs are one voice (one org); the npm package page is the second voice that satisfies the two-voices rule. (obj-03-b)

items.prompt: During the traced publish, where was the gate for the new version recorded?
options: Inside the publish receipt's inputs, at publish time — before any learner interaction
In the Telegram card sent to learners
In the system's current state, readable by the learn workflow
items.explanation: The gate is pre-registered inside the publish receipt: written before data arrives, immune to post-hoc rationalisation, quotable by the revert receipt that later fires. (obj-03-b)
